pythonFunction.name: complete_converged_checkout
pythonFunction.description:
Injects all 3 pillars of the Cymbal One Converged Home Bundle plus the -£12.00 INV-8841 refund credit and free priority installation into basket_state, pre-provisions ServiceNow ticket INC-904821 (Thursday, 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM) with attached telemetry and 3-disc house placement plan in servicenow_handover_payload, and returns the checkout_and_servicenow storefront payload.

Call this tool silently alongside update_storefront_ui(view='checkout_and_servicenow') without speaking a pre-call filler phrase first.

When to Call:
- Call in Stage 5 when the customer confirms they want help with installation, agrees to upgrade their home, or asks to add the Cymbal One Converged Home Bundle to their basket.

When NOT to Call:
- Do NOT call before the customer has explored the bundle and confirmed they want to proceed.
